notes.note: event-store.ts change (#4992) adds a per-thread cache to listSessionProjectionEventsForThreads and countEventsByThreads, keyed by each thread's highest global_sequence, bypassed under STATION_DISABLE_EVENT_STORE_CACHES and inside open transactions. Checked this document's EventStore claims (composition of ledgers/journals/workers, ingress stamping, close/fencing, attachment storage and bindings, steer-input binding); none describe the session projection fold or its caching, and attachment bytes are still read from the blob store at return time, so the documented behavior is unchanged.
